references.title: Phase I clinical study of crenezumab in patients with alzheimer's disease

characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled study and unblinded, uncontrolled, long-term study

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Subjects aged 50-84 years 

"Diagnosed as having probable AD dementia based on the National Institute on Aging and the Alzheimer's Association (NIA-AA) core diagnostic criteria, or diagnosed as having mild to moderate dementia due to AD based on DSM-V
MMSE score is 18 to 28 at screening"

references.authors: Joseph-Mathurin N, Llibre-Guerra JJ, Li Y, McCullough AA, Hofmann C, Wojtowicz J, et al
references.title: Amyloid-related imaging abnormalities in the DIAN-TU-001 trial of gantenerumab and solanezumab: lessons from a trial in dominantly inherited alzheimer disease

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value: Mutation carriers (known DIAD pathogenic mutations, Presenilin1, Presenilin2, or APP genes), no cognitive symptoms or early dementia

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value:
-Dementia severity

-Cognitive function

-Amyloid-related imaging abnormality 

-Symptomatic ARIA-E or ARIA-H

-Symptomatic brain haemorrhage
